length_reference.basis: body + question + example; each language ~10-15 min, need not match (editor-in-chief 2026-11-01); guidance only, never a rejection criterion

site_wait.note: live-check retries after the site commit (~22 min); the retry timer resumes later runs until send_deadline

editor.note: bounded editor loop per draft; drafts still open after max_attempts wait for a person. The fix/block threshold is never relaxed here.

final_editor.runtime: claude_cli (official Claude Code CLI on the Pi, claude.ai subscription)
final_editor.note: attempts are genuine editorial attempts (health failures not counted), counted since the last demotion from checked; each continues from the previous final text and open issues; a new attempt starts only if the job deadline leaves min_minutes_per_attempt; after max_attempts the draft stays pending. Thresholds are never relaxed.

context_review.note: normalised characters around each excerpt (more after than before), one bounded search round for long sources; see context.py

mix.note: owner decision 2026-10-31 (docs/ADDENDUM_READER_FEEDBACK_20261031.md): ~4 China (ancient+modern) / 3 elsewhere per 7, soft target; see mix.py. Replaces the equal rotation below, which is kept only as the list of categories.

rotation_legacy_note: rotation is no longer used for scheduling (mix.py); kept for old reports

writer.model: claude-opus-5-5 (claude_cli.MODEL; the CLI reports the model actually used)
writer.runtime: claude_cli (official Claude Code CLI on the Pi, claude.ai subscription)
writer.note: owner decision 2026-11-01: Claude drafts, writes the English and edits; MiMo/Hermes left the main chain (no fallback). Writing and review stay separate calls and records.

schedule_note: owner decision 2026-11-01: daily send 22:08 Beijing time (Asia/Shanghai; = 06:08 PST / 07:08 PDT in Los Angeles). Edition dates, subjects and duplicate checks use the Beijing date; the send window closes at 23:40 the same Beijing day (never sent on a later day). Nightly drafting at 10:00 Beijing time.

supply.note: books first (library.py); a book unit without a complete episode is skipped with a reason, so a night may try a few units per needed category; bounded
